quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: server products were over 60% of sales revenue, with AI server products the core growth engine; AI compute-related products grew 242% year on year. The company says it entered the core PCB supply chain for key components of leading customers and brought AI server, OAM and UBB high-end products to large-scale mass production. PCB production 172.98 ten-thousand square metres (+17.55%), sales 171.62 ten-thousand square metres (+17.80%), inventory 21.68 ten-thousand square metres (+6.69%); direct materials were 73.37% of PCB cost. It flags that the share of server orders and of overseas sales keeps rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (2025 annual report): construction in progress RMB 1,021,383,702.11 at year-end, up 254.96%, mainly the intelligent computing center high-multilayer HDI interconnect board project phase 1 and Thailand plant phase 1. The Dongguan intelligent computing center project (planned investment about RMB 14 hundred million) ran phase 1 trial production in 2025 with output meeting expected targets. The Ji'an intelligent manufacturing high-layer-count computing board project (about RMB 19 hundred million) is planned in two stages of 35 ten-thousand square metres a year each. The Dongguan AI computing HDI production base (about RMB 20 hundred million) has acquired about 40 mu of land. Thailand plant phase 1 (high-computing high-end boards; budget RMB 1,034,040,000.00, 17.62% complete) received its Thailand BOI investment certificate in March 2025 and its main building was topped out by end-2025; the company targets production in 2026, entering equipment commissioning and trial production, and is pushing customer qualification. The Dongcheng plant phase 4 5G high-speed high-density PCB project, now producing HDI, optical-module and rigid-flex boards at scale, made net profit of RMB 63,509.66 ten-thousand in 2025.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (2025 annual report): the company will keep focusing on structural growth in high-end markets and seize the AI compute wave to achieve further high-quality, sustainable growth, deepening existing customers while targeting large overseas customers; it says some key raw materials face tightening supply and rising costs, and it will deepen strategic coordination with core suppliers and use diversified sourcing and forward stocking to secure deliveries; new capacity is to be brought on as planned.
